author: Astrokillah
text:
I am shattering my own expectation, the account has grown above 550.
Somehow, there is a voice inside me that is warning me to stop the
scalping madness, heck, you're making too much money at the misery of
others, stop or karma shall come

I guess, I need to take a break from trading, this is the last time I'll
 be showing my statement here, I apologize if I've been seen as showing
off too much. In a way, I am beyond ecstatic with my performance lately.
 I started trading in March 2016, I thought trading is a piece of cake,
and I'm someone with very high IQ, and then within 3 months I have lost
$40k. I took my humble pill, I started paying for trading courses
(supply and demand, Elliott Waves, Market Makers, ICT), I started taking
 smaller risk, but in the following months that ensued, I lost another
$20k, so I said, enough is enough. Then I came to RTM, and studied the
heck out of it for 3 months. And then on the 4th month, I got my
breakthrough, my demo in November gave me +47%, and in December gave me
another 40% ++, then in January 2018 I went LIVE again, and I have made
back all my previous losses in less than 2 months. Even though I made
money through scalping, but without RTM, teaching me how to look at
1-min chart, I wouldn't have thought of scalping at all. The
conventional wisdom (all the poisons being spilled outside of RTM) is
that 1-min chart is crap, too much noise, unreliable, and is a sure way
to blow your account
 I am really happy, in a way that 99% of the traders think this way,
let them continue to trade on HTF. Honestly, it's difficult for me to
go back to HTF, if I can make a thousands within a few minutes through
scalping, why would I want to go back to my past - trading H4 and Daily?

I have to stop my rant. Just want to say thank you to EVERYONE here who
had helped me - you know who you are. I cannot thank you enough.

Thank you RTM

Thank you Master IF

Thank you Master Mertch

Thank you Master Harry

Thank you Master Salivan, Pedini, Les_Paul, Doctor

author: Rinehart
text:
Your journal entries have been very inspiring. I understand it might
come across as bragging. But try to realize that very few traders ever
show account statements and when they do it is only a snapshot -- 1 good
 day or week. It is incredibly rare to see something like what you have
 done---months and months of low drawdown exponential growth. You have
shown it is possible to become a full time trader with low drawdown
using RTM principles. Breathtaking!

I'd like to add a public service announcement if I may: PLEASE DO NOT PRIVATE MESSAGE AK!!! DO NOT ASK HIM FOR HELP! DO NOT CONTACT HIM. WE DO NOT WANT TO BURN HIM OUT!!!
 I've been in trading forums for a long time. When someone starts
doing REALLY REALLY well they share their success because they want
other to know it is possible. Others take notice and start asking
questions, sending private messages, dissecting their trades. Then the
person who was doing well feeling obligated to help others and spends
tons of time answering PMs and trying to help others. Soon people start
 asking why the trade they put on just like theirs failed. They start
asking for answers that are not easily given. Eventually the newly
successful trader decides they have had enough and they go dark. I have
 seen this happen over and over again. If you want to achieve AK's
success. Study the RTM material like he did. Study his journal and his
 posts in other peoples' journals. And finally polite encourage him to
keep posting.....period!
